description: This file defines the interface for a Lua binding of a 3D vector type, including structure definitions, function prototypes for vector creation, printing, various vector operations, and binding functions for Lua integration.

classes.name: lu5_vector
classes.description: A 3D vector structure with components x, y, z of type lua_Number.

methods.name: createVector
methods.description: Creates a new vector instance with specified components.

methods.name: lu5_vector_print
methods.description: Prints the vector in a human-readable form.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dist
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_dot
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_add
methods.description: Returns the sum of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_sub
methods.description: Returns the difference between two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mult
methods.description: Returns the element-wise product of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_div
methods.description: Returns the element-wise division of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_idiv
methods.description: Returns the element-wise integer division of two vectors.

methods.name: lu5_vector_copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of a vector.

methods.name: lu5_bind_vector
methods.description: Binds the vector type to the Lua state.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mut_mult
methods.description: Mutably multiplies a vector by another vector.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mut_sub
methods.description: Mutably subtracts another vector from a vector.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mut_div
methods.description: Mutably divides a vector by another vector.

methods.name: lu5_vector_mut_idiv
methods.description: Mutably performs integer division on a vector by another vector.
